name: pdh_pdl_fakeout_v141
mechanism: On NIFTY, Previous Day High and Low are the most-referenced technical levels by retail stop-loss placement, options strike clustering, and institutional VWAP desks. When the index probes above PDH intraday, cascading stop-buy orders and breakout algos create a brief overshooting spike — but large institutional VWAP desks do not chase pokes above PDH, leaving only fast-money longs who entered the spike exposed. Within 30-90 seconds the spike fails, and option market makers who are short gamma near these strike-proximate levels delta-hedge aggressively on reversal, amplifying the return below PDH. The fakeout bar itself (5s bar has high > PDH but closes back below) is the cleanest entry signal available at 5-second resolution.
core_signal_oneliner: Previous day high/low fakeout reversal: single 5s bar whose high exceeds PDH/PDL but closes back inside, confirming stop-hunt rejection
